import slugkit.core as sk
# Test cases from acceptance criteria
tests = [
    ("Hello--World", "hello-world"),
    ("a -- b", "a-b"),
    ("one , two ; three", "one-two-three"),
    ("x___y", "x-y"),
    ("end!", "end"),
    ("  padded  ", "padded"),
    ("--both--", "both"),
    ("(parens)", "parens"),
    ("", ""),
    ("!!!", ""),
    ("   ", ""),
    ("Hello World", "hello-world"),
    ("already-a-slug", "already-a-slug"),
    ("Python 3", "python-3"),
    ("MiXeD CaSe 42", "mixed-case-42"),
    ("caf\u00e9 cr\u00e8me", "caf-cr-me"),
    ("\u65e5\u672c\u8a9e", ""),
]
all_ok = True
for inp, expected in tests:
    got = sk.slugify(inp)
    if got != expected:
        print(f"FAIL: slugify({repr(inp)}) = {repr(got)} expected {repr(expected)}")
        all_ok = False
if all_ok:
    print("All acceptance tests passed.")
# Test TypeError for non-string
for bad in [None, 3, 2.5, ['a'], b'bytes']:
    try:
        sk.slugify(bad)
        print(f"FAIL: Expected TypeError for {bad}")
        all_ok = False
    except TypeError:
        pass
if all_ok:
    print("All tests passed.")
else:
    raise AssertionError("Some tests failed")
